result.title: Commit2Drive: Perception-Grounded Language Decisions as Commitments for Trajectory Planning in Vision-Language-Action Driving Models
result.comment: 28 pages, 9 figures, 19 tables. Includes supplementary material. Code will be released soon
result.summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models introduce language reasoning into end-to-end autonomous driving. They output a language decision together with a trajectory, which makes the planner more interpretable. However, in existing methods the language decision is either an independent output or an index that selects among similar candidate trajectories, and its annotations are not verified against the trajectory. As a result, the language decision and the trajectory are often inconsistent in closed-loop driving. To address this, we propose Commit2Drive, a framework that imposes the language decision as a consistency constraint on trajectory planning. The decision is a commitment, a maneuver class with a continuous parameter that one deterministic rule reads from any trajectory, and it is grounded in facts reported by the perception of the model itself. A Maneuver Bank maps the commitment to a code with a kinematic meaning, and consistency losses train the planner to execute every admissible decision of a scene, so that the trajectory follows the decision. An automatic data pipeline supplies the supervision. Decisions are labeled from the future motion of the expert, counterfactual executions train the decision and the trajectory together, and rule-based functions with a Vision-Language Model (VLM) generate, review and refine the language annotations. The code is a lookup that involves no hidden state of the language model, so Commit2Drive is extensible to rule-based decisions, which the same planner executes without retraining. Commit2Drive uses a 0.5B language model and runs closed-loop inference online on a single consumer graphics card. On Bench2Drive, Commit2Drive reaches a Driving Score (DS) of 78.50 and a Success Rate (SR) of 55.91% with a lightweight model, which is competitive with the state of the art, and greatly reduces the language-action inconsistency. Code will be released soon.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Commit2Drive：把语言决策定义为带连续参数的机动类「承诺」，由确定性规则从任意轨迹读出并以模型自身感知事实为据，配合机动码本、一致性损失与反事实执行联合训练规划器，另有 VLM 辅助的自动标注管线，在 Bench2Drive 闭环取得 78.50 DS。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「语言决策—轨迹」一致性约束与反事实监督可供核查 VLM 推理中答案是否真正作用于输出、以及贡献分配与监督设计；但决策码仅由查表得到、不涉及语言模型隐状态，与 latent 状态生成关系较远，迁移价值需人工判断。
